tasks.short: Read orders and determine heat-cycle requirements

steps.what: Find the current production schedules, work orders and authorised heat-treatment specification for the actual lot in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS}.
outputs: Correct current order and specification pages

steps.what: Inspect the actual objects and lot identification against the order and resolve discrepancies before choosing the processing requirements.
outputs: Confirmed lot context or held mismatch

steps.what: Read the authorised requirements and determine processing sequences, furnace temperatures and heat cycle requirements for the confirmed objects, escalating ambiguity.
outputs: Understood processing requirements or unresolved exception

steps.what: Write and check the actual requirement references and unresolved issues in the existing work-order preparation note {OPS_SYSTEM}.
outputs: Checked final preparation note

steps.what: Save that checked preparation note in the work order {OPS_SYSTEM}.
outputs: Saved actual requirement reference

tasks.design: Configure lot-linked current-order and specification views in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS}. Shorten locating the released instructions, keeping actual lot verification and requirement interpretation. No model generates a heat cycle or changes a machine setting.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current instructions are repeatedly found across order and document screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Native order-document links and revision filters.
tasks.still_hard: Lot mismatches and unclear authorised requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Stopping when the objects or instructions do not match.

evidence.claim: Native order-linked specification views can reduce repeated instruction retrieval while actual applicability remains human.

assumptions: E1 active-work allocation, not measured. Saving requires real repeated retrieval; already linked current instructions yield zero.

Production planning and authorised process staff produce the released lot order and specification. s1 obtains actual lot ID, order revision and specification revision; missing links are resolved manually. s2 establishes the physical match, not a free clean input.

The small note is an existing preparation record, not a newly invented report. Its writing and save have no saving. s4's ordinary final check gates its exact save without added self-approval. No control-setting commit or physical treatment is included.
research_questions: Does lot-linked retrieval always resolve to the released specification revision?

already_counted.description: Source inspection, physical lot verification, requirement interpretation, actual note and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain order-to-specification links and revision tests.

approvals.approved_version: Exact preparation note checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20 x 40% retrieval reduction = 8 gross points less 1 upkeep; no interpretation, physical or save saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Observe the actual parts being removed from the furnace and confirm the physical lot and removal event.
outputs: Observed actual removal for the identified lot

steps.what: Capture the actual removal time, lot and furnace identifier in the source event note at the time of observation.
outputs: Actual removal event note

steps.what: Read the actual furnace cycle and temperature record and identify the evidence for the required time at temperature.
outputs: Relevant actual cycle evidence and unresolved deviations

steps.what: Copy the captured actual removal times and lot identifiers into the batch treatment record and attach the selected actual cycle reference.
outputs: Completed draft batch treatment record

steps.what: Check the completed batch record against the actual removal event, lot identity and temperature evidence, retaining deviations rather than asserting compliance from a timestamp alone.
outputs: Checked final batch record or held discrepancy

steps.what: Commit the exact checked batch treatment record in {OPS_SYSTEM}.
outputs: Saved actual removal and treatment-evidence record

tasks.design: Where an actual source note is recopied today, configure one native removal-event form in {OPS_SYSTEM} and reuse its fields in the batch draft. Keep the operator's real event capture and selection of the actual furnace-controller {OTHER} cycle record. A timestamp does not prove the parts met the treatment specification.
tasks.previous_blocker: A real removal event is captured once and then recopied to the batch record.
tasks.enabler_now: Native event forms can reuse lot, furnace, actual removal time and selected cycle reference.
tasks.still_hard: Identifying the actual lot and judging whether cycle evidence supports the requirement.
tasks.human_edge: Observing what happened and retaining deviations honestly.

ambition.what: Remove repeat transcription of actual event data.

evidence.claim: Native production event forms can reuse actual captured fields in a batch draft without inferring physical completion or treatment adequacy.

assumptions: This is a conditional E1 repeat-transcription scenario, not a measured baseline or claim that every furnace uses two records. If the operator records once already, the proposed saving is zero.

s2 actually produces removal time, lot ID and furnace ID through operator capture; future native form capture retains all 15% effort. s3 actually selects the existing controller cycle ID and reads its evidence. No planned cycle end, conveyor command or automatic calendar event substitutes for observed removal.
s4 only reuses captured fields in an uncommitted draft. Missing event fields, uncertain clock alignment or unmatched cycle IDs require manual handling; no clean sensor integration is assumed.

s5 is the ordinary final evidence check, supplying the exact commit gate without added self-approval work. The 1% commit tail is fully retained. No product-release certificate, shipment or other-role quality sign-off is automated.
research_questions: Can one native capture preserve actual removal time and lot identity during interruptions and deviations?

already_counted.description: Actual observation/capture, cycle-evidence review, final reconciliation and commit remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain event-to-batch field mappings and investigate clock or cycle mismatches.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed batch record checked against actual event and cycle evidence in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 25 points of actual repeated transcription removed, less 2 upkeep. No machine runtime, initial capture, physical removal or treatment-judgment saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Start conveyors and open furnaces for loading

steps.what: Confirm the actual stock, furnace assignment and authorised loading job against the current work order.
outputs: Confirmed loading context

steps.what: Perform the existing immediate readiness check for opening the specific furnace door in the actual current conditions.
inputs: Current conditions and established safe procedure
outputs: Immediate exact door-operation go or hold

steps.what: Open the exact checked furnace door using the existing authorised controls and procedure.
outputs: Actual furnace door state

steps.what: Check the specific conveyor and present loading conditions immediately before the authorised start.
outputs: Immediate exact conveyor-start go or hold

steps.what: Start the exact checked conveyor through the established controls.
inputs: Immediate checked start scope from s4
outputs: Actual conveyor state

steps.what: Check the actual stock and current equipment state for the specific next loading movement under the existing procedure.
outputs: Immediate exact loading-movement go or hold

steps.what: Load the stock through the authorised physical operation while monitoring the actual movement and stopping if conditions change.
inputs: Immediate checked loading scope from s6
outputs: Actual loaded stock or stopped operation

tasks.design: No change or saving for the direct conveyor-and-furnace loading branch. Separate immediate readiness decisions from each physical control action. Existing machinery automation is not new saved operator labour.
tasks.previous_blocker: The operation depends on real stock, equipment state and site controls.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability demonstrated for this physical workflow.
tasks.human_edge: Immediate situational awareness and stopping authority.

evidence.claim: Existing physical machinery operation and immediate readiness decisions do not become new labour savings merely by describing their controls as software.

assumptions: Illustrative E1 direct-loading branch of the task's alternative methods. No crane-operator labour or signal saving is claimed; a crane branch requires its actual coordination and separately checked signal.

The positive readiness steps describe ordinary existing safe-work checks for each specific imminent action, not added administrative approvals. A changed stock, state or scope requires recheck. No operational parameters or new control logic are supplied.

No separate worker-written report is required for this loading act. Existing automatic controller logs are system runtime, not invented manual records. Any actual completion record belongs to its real recording task; actual removal recording in 12088 is a later distinct event and cannot be inferred from this loading.
research_questions: Is any actual separate record written by this operator during loading? If so, measure and model it before claiming savings.

already_counted.description: All lot checks, immediate readiness decisions and physical actions remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact imminent furnace-door operation checked in s2
Exact imminent conveyor start checked in s4
Exact imminent stock loading movement checked in s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All actual physical and decision steps remain at 100%; no existing controller runtime or unevidenced administrative work is counted as a saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Instruct new workers in machine operation

steps.what: Find and inspect the current approved machine-operation training pages for the actual machine and new worker's learning needs in {DOCS}.
outputs: Relevant current training pages

steps.what: Instruct new workers in machine operation through actual explanation, supervised demonstration and observed practice under existing site controls.
outputs: Delivered instruction and observed capability or remaining gaps

steps.what: Write and check the actual instruction delivered and observed gaps in the existing training log {LMS}.
inputs: Actual instruction and observations from s2
outputs: Checked final training-log entry

steps.what: Save the checked actual training-log entry in the {LMS}.
outputs: Saved instruction record

tasks.design: Configure machine and revision filters in the approved {DOCS} training library. Keep the actual instruction and observed practice human. No model invents operating instructions or certifies readiness.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current machine-specific pages are repeatedly located among old copies.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising what the new worker understands in practice.

evidence.claim: Current machine-specific document filters can reduce training-material lookup while actual instruction stays human.

assumptions: Unmeasured E1 allocation where repeated manual lookup exists; already accessible current material gives zero saving.

Approved process staff produce source pages. The operator actually inspects them in s1 and observes learning in s2. Any live machine action retains its existing exact-operation safe-work controls; none is automated by this document change.

The existing brief training log is actually written after instruction, not inferred from scheduled attendance. s3's ordinary final check gates its exact fully retained save without added self-approval labour. The record is not independent machine-operation authorisation.
research_questions: Do native filters reliably select the current machine-specific approved pages?

already_counted.description: Source inspection, all instruction and observed practice, actual training entry and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain machine tags and current revision links.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual instruction entry checked in s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 8 x 25% lookup reduction = 2 gross points less 0.5 upkeep. Physical instruction and record tails have no saving.
